data.one_liner: Fast, cross‑platform PDF viewer and editor widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑to‑use widgets to display, edit, combine and manipulate PDF documents. Uses PDFium (or optional CoreGraphics) for rendering on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and Web.
use_when: You need interactive PDF viewing with editing features
Your app targets multiple desktop and mobile platforms
You require high‑performance rendering of large PDFs
avoid_when: App size must be minimal and native binaries are undesirable
You only need static PDF display without editing
You cannot install a C toolchain or enable Windows Developer Mode
strengths: Rich feature set (view, edit, combine, image import)
Supports all major Flutter platforms including Web
Optional CoreGraphics rendering to reduce app size on Apple platforms
weaknesses: Requires native build toolchain and C compiler
Windows builds need Developer Mode enabled
Large native binaries may increase app size
data.setup_notes: Install a C toolchain for native builds; enable Developer Mode on Windows; iOS/macOS require CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager for PDFium XCFramework; optional pdfrx_coregraphics package for Apple platforms.
